title: Good: constant-time token comparison
description: The codebase consistently uses subtle::ConstantTimeEq for secret comparisons: client_secret verification (api.rs:788), WriteFreely edit tokens (writefreely_api.rs:110,128,187,205), and passkey token verification (webauthn.rs:488-491). The passkey token verification even does a full constant-time scan of all entries to avoid timing leaks on the key lookup. This is thorough and correct.
